Problem Statement:
Write a program to reverse the order of words in a given string. 
Input Description:
1. Words are separated by spaces.
2. Maintain the words' internal order but reverse their sequence.
A single string s (1 \u2264 length \u2264 1000). 
Output Description:
Print the reversed sentence. 
Sample Input:
Hello World in Java 
Sample Output:
Java in World Hello
